title: Package guides and contracts corrected against the code
summary: The `README.md` and `SPEC.md` that `@inventarch/language`, `@inventarch/graph`, `@inventarch/compliance`, `@inventarch/db`, `@inventarch/runtime`, `@inventarch/workspace-runtime`, `@inventarch/service-contracts` and `@inventarch/cli` ship were checked against their code. They now document exit class 4 for an unreachable remote registry or archive, the `db` and `runtime` error models, and the `workspace-runtime` and `service-contracts` entry points, and they correct statements that did not hold, such as a browser bundle `service-contracts` never built and the revision a runtime position body carries. Documentation only: no code, behavior or API changes.
